zones.summary: Active luthier workshop on the property — violins, mandolins, tool wall, workbench. Sammer (instrument-maker, venue resident) is a separate doc subject; documentary on him is happening either way.
activities: Documentary subject: Sammer (luthier) — own doc thread
Hands-on B-roll workshop: cinematography of craft (close-ups, hands, tools)
Sound design exercise: tap, scrape, string-pluck textures recorded room-tone
zones.creative_notes: Window on rear wall opens onto valley + olive grove. Daylight only late morning until early afternoon (window faces N/NW based on sun position).

zones.summary: Single-bed dorm rooms. Some have years of signatures, names, drawings — past participants left their marks. Per meeting notes, girls' rooms are on the 3rd floor next to admin.
activities: Scene seed: stories pulled from wall imagery (meeting note 01:51)
Intimate dialogue scenes — natural backlight from windows
Documentary motif: name-graffiti as visual through-line for the cohort doc
zones.creative_notes: Strong backlit silhouettes at midday (windows face SW/W). Dim interiors create natural chiaroscuro. Wall art is a built-in production-design asset.

zones.summary: Two stall-bathroom corridors (pink-pastel and blue-pastel doors). Per meeting note 01:51 — "الحمام رهيب" — a scene candidate.
activities: Scene candidate: bathroom scene (per meeting)
Mirror / vent-fan / vanishing-point compositions
Lighting exercise: practical-light scene with overhead fluorescents
zones.creative_notes: Strong perspective corridor of stall doors. Daylight only via window at far end + extractor fan halo.

zones.summary: Second-tier bathroom with water-damaged ceiling, exposed conduit, peeling tile. Strong texture and horror-/period-set potential per meeting note 02:09 — "old beautiful spaces — horror-scene potential".
activities: Horror / period genre set
Texture & lighting drill: hard-light through small window
Sound design exercise: dripping / pipe ambience
zones.creative_notes: Direct shaft of light from a small upper window. Heavy decay = visual identity.

zones.summary: Flat concrete roof with 360° view of Birzeit. Meeting notes 02:09 — natural-light workshop: reflections, controlling light, multiple windows. Sun-path: rise 05:45 / set 19:26 on 11 May; arc swings south through midday.
activities: Natural-light workshop (reflections, controlling light, multiple windows)
Sunrise / sunset photography sessions
Golden-hour cohort portraits (1 hr before sunset = ~18:25)
Drone / overhead establishing shots of Birzeit (pending venue + Civil Aviation permission)
zones.creative_notes: Open sky, no overhangs on most of the deck. Stairwell hut + water tanks are usable foreground. Watch heat — August midday is brutal; bias to early-morning + late-afternoon blocks.

zones.summary: Music rehearsal hall with grand piano, music stands, ~30 chairs. Pink+white acoustic panels. Per meeting 01:32 — "multiple halls, including a big one". Best candidate for plenary lectures, screenings, and music workshops.
activities: Plenary briefings + screenings (bring our own projector + screen)
Score-to-picture workshop (use the grand piano)
Director Q&A / masterclass setup
Group critique sessions
zones.creative_notes: High ceilings → good for boom-mic / dialogue scenes. Daylight side from a tall multi-pane window. Acoustic panels keep room from over-ringing.

zones.summary: Large dining/cafeteria hall with tables + chairs, big windows, pastel pink+peach tiled accent wall. We will not be using the venue's food ~90% — cooked / brought from Ramallah — so this hall is mostly multi-use seating.
activities: Meals (breakfast / lunch / dinner — meals plan owner: TBD)
Evening recap circles
Doubles as classroom overflow when the music hall is in use
Content-shoot day: cohort dinners are doc gold
zones.creative_notes: Pastel wall tiles work as wide-aspect backdrop — read warm on uncorrected daylight.

zones.summary: Multiple smaller practice rooms with high ceilings, percussion / drum stash, easels, storage cupboards. Per meeting — "halls, multiple".
activities: Editing room setups (2–3 stations per room)
Sound mixing / Foley closet
Color-grading review with controlled light (close windows + curtain)
Breakouts when whole cohort splits into tracks
zones.creative_notes: Some rooms still cluttered with the institute's gear — plan a clean-up window with Amjad before camp.

zones.summary: Per meeting 01:32 — "multiple options; will use the ground floor one". Empty grey metal shelving units, ready to be loaded with Kawader gear cases.
activities: Centralised gear check-in/out station
Daily kit sign-out log + barcode scan (matches Odoo serial pre-selection workflow)
Mohanad + 2 youth based here on rotation for security
zones.creative_notes: Empty, lockable, on the path to the courtyard — choose this over any upper-floor room because we don't want gear hauled up stairs.

zones.summary: Two storage spaces full of old binders, beds, wood, archive material. Not for daily use, but visually rich.
activities: Set-dressing inventory (real props — old wood, doors, archive paper)
Texture / object photography drill
Genre-set candidate: cellar / archive / detective scene
zones.creative_notes: Heavy dust = mask up for any extended shoot. Don't move historical archives — institute's property.

zones.summary: Stone garden walls, dirt paths, mature olive + pine trees, picnic bench, ember-bed BBQ trough, decorative stone outbuilding hidden in trees. Walled compound around the building.
activities: Exterior camera-movement drills (steadicam, gimbal, dolly)
Group photo + ID portraits under olive trees
Communal cook-fire / shared meal (BBQ trough is operational)
Outdoor circle for partner workshops (Circus School could drop in here)
Plein-air scene shoots — natural light, full control
zones.creative_notes: Shade quality changes hourly — south side gets full sun midday, north side stays shaded after ~14:00. Best ambient sound block 08:00–10:00 + 17:00–19:00 (avoid mosque + traffic peaks).

zones.summary: Arabic-language wall writings across rooms and the rooftop. Two striking pieces: 'سجن حينما يحسم التوقعة' (cell / prison metaphor) and 'الحرية التي لا مقابل لها إنما هي المقابل' (Freedom that has no price is itself the price). Powerful visual identity for the camp.
activities: Title-design source material (camp brand / promo teaser)
Photography prompt: typography in space
Recurring B-roll motif across the doc
zones.creative_notes: Verify with Amjad which writings are part of the institute's heritage (do not paint over) and which are open to reinterpretation. Treat as living archive.

zones.summary: Window framings overlooking the courtyard, neighbouring buildings, Birzeit valley, and the old town. Naturally cinematic.
activities: Establishing shots / opening sequence
Rule-of-thirds framing exercise (use window as natural matte)
Promo teaser cutaways
zones.creative_notes: South-facing windows = harsh midday, magic at 17:00+. North-facing = consistent soft light all day.

zones.summary: Narrow corridor with overhead pipes, water-damaged ceiling, stacked gas cylinders. Rough, atmospheric.
activities: Atmospheric / horror scene set
Sound design environment (drips, pipe knocks, low rumble)
Lighting drill: practical bare-bulb + flashlight scene
zones.creative_notes: Safety: gas cylinders + low ceiling. Light it cold (3200K minus green). No open flame.

zones.summary: Green chalkboard + easel surfaces present on site. Useful for whiteboarding shoot plans, schedules.
activities: Daily call-sheet board (one per track)
Storyboarding station
Schedule visibility
zones.creative_notes: Chalk doubles as on-set art department supply.

zones.summary: Old stove + fridge in a disused kitchen. Visible through a barred opening. Not for cooking — we cook off-site or in the active institute kitchen.
activities: Production design asset
Period scene candidate
zones.creative_notes: Heavy patina — minimal dressing needed for an 80s/90s period scene.

zones.summary: Rusted double iron door with a painted red arrow — a single visually arresting object on the compound.
activities: Title card / poster background
Doorway portrait drill (single subject, single light)
zones.creative_notes: Symbolism on-tap: the red arrow as direction motif for the camp.

zones.summary: Front of Edward Said Institute — limestone Palestinian masonry, recessed grilled windows, pergola, palm + olive in frame.
activities: Group cohort shot — arrival day
Wide establishing of the venue
Doc opening establishing shot

partners.workshop: Camera movement using circus tools + body capability
